Axiom: For every non-trivial construct the diff introduces, ask ONE question before anything else: could this achieve the same result with less code, less indirection, fewer moving parts? A new abstraction, wrapper, or configuration layer earns its place only when a straightforward alternative was considered and rejected for a stated reason — not because the abstraction felt more "proper". Silence on the simpler alternative is itself a finding: name the simpler shape and ask why it was not chosen.
